filterLibrary.label: Material
filterLibrary.tooltip: Select the main fabric material used in the product.

filterLibrary.label: Pattern
filterLibrary.tooltip: Choose the main pattern used in the product.

filters.label: Brand Name
filters.tooltip: Enter the official brand name associated with the product.

filters.label: Model Name
filters.tooltip: Enter the specific model name or identifier assigned to the product by the brand or manufacturer.

filters.label: Manufacturer
filters.tooltip: Enter the official manufacturer name associated with the product.

filters.label: Fit Type
filters.tooltip: Choose the fit style that best describes the product.

filters.label: Collar Style
filters.tooltip: Select the collar design that best matches the product (e.g., Spread, Mandarin, Wingtip).

filters.label: Neck Style
filters.tooltip: Select the neckline design that best describes the product (e.g., Crew Neck, V-Neck, Turtleneck).

filters.label: Sleeve Type
filters.tooltip: Select the sleeve design that best describes the product (e.g., Short Sleeve, Sleeveless, Three-Quarter Sleeve).

filters.label: Sport Type
filters.tooltip: Select the sport or activity the product is best suited for (e.g., Running, Swimming, Yoga).

filters.label: Lifestyle
filters.tooltip: Select the lifestyle or dress code the product is best suited for (e.g., Casual, Business Casual, Formal).

filters.label: Seasons
filters.tooltip: Select the season(s) during which the product is most suitable for wear (e.g., Summer, Winter).

filters.label: Closure Type
filters.tooltip: Select the fastening method used to close the product (e.g., Button, Zipper, Velcro).

filters.label: Cuff Type
filters.tooltip: Select the cuff design or fastening style used on the product (e.g., Button Cuff, French Cuff, Elastic Cuff).

filters.label: Occasion
filters.tooltip: Select the occasion or event where the product is most suitable to wear (e.g., Anniversary, Graduation, Wedding).

filters.label: Origin
filters.tooltip: Specify the country or region where the product was manufactured or sourced (e.g., Made in Kenya, Imported).

filters.label: Age Description
filters.tooltip: Select the age group the product is designed for (e.g., Adult, Senior).

filters.label: Pocket Description
filters.tooltip: Specify the type and placement of pockets on the product (e.g., Side Pockets, Chest Pocket, Cargo Pockets).

filters.label: Sustainability Features
filters.tooltip: Highlight any eco-friendly or sustainable qualities of the product (e.g., Organic Material, Recycled Fabric, Biodegradable).

filters.label: Customizable Product
filters.tooltip: Indicate whether the product can be customized (e.g., Personalized Text, Custom Size, Custom Color).

filters.label: Fabric Type
filters.tooltip: Specify the fabric type used in the product (e.g., Denim, Silk, Jersey, 50% Polyester, 50% Cotton).

filters.label: Product Care Instructions
filters.tooltip: Provide clear care guidelines for maintaining the product (e.g., Hand Wash Recommended, Dry Clean Only, Machine Wash).

filters.label: Special Features
filters.tooltip: Highlight any unique or standout qualities of the product (e.g., Water Resistant, Breathable, Quick Dry).

filters.label: Fabric Weight Class
filters.tooltip: Select the fabric weight category that best describes the product (e.g., Lightweight for summer wear, Heavyweight for winter wear).

filters.label: Fit to Size
filters.tooltip: Describe how the product fits compared to standard sizing (e.g., True to Size, Runs Small, Runs Large).

filters.label: Weight
filters.tooltip: Specify the product’s weight, including units (e.g., 500g, 2kg, 1.5 lbs).

filters.label: Item Size Country
filters.tooltip: Select the sizing standard or country reference used for the product (e.g., US sizes, UK sizes, EU sizes).
